authorization: User expressly approved production migration 286, corresponding API and cleanup cron, and committing/deploying all pending updates to Vercel. Prior request approved clearing the two developer placeholder descriptions while keeping normal descriptions.

policy.plushie: No Free/Plus daily quota; 10 authenticated upload requests per actor/hour across all toys/targets; one current owner+toy photo. Pending immutable upload protection remains.
policy.oldPlushieFiles: One-hour grace, five-minute worker schedule; healthy target 60-65 minutes, retries retained on storage/acknowledgement failure.
policy.freeFrames: Non-current history older than 30 days retired and cleaned; one currently displayable photo per owner exempt. Free 7-day history visibility and daily upload quotas unchanged.
policy.plusExpiry: Free rules use original photo age; upgrading does not restore retired/deleted history.

releaseBoundary.localOnlyOutputs: QA screenshots, exports and retired-resource recovery archive preserved locally and excluded from Git/Vercel. Sanitized reports and source/test/assets are committed.
releaseBoundary.clientAvailability: Reload Metro to use committed client changes, or include in a separately authorized future App build. Vercel does not replace installed native App UI.

limitations: Queueing and cron registration do not prove physical deletion has occurred; no one-hour live wait was performed. External outages/backlog may delay deletion, with retry work retained.

The prior Admin source listing returned 404 beyond platform retention. All 903 candidate source hashes were verified against the reviewed local snapshot, but not against the old deployment's unavailable source.
SQL tests use isolated single-engine PGlite, not multi-connection load or real-user transactions.
No new simulator, physical haptic, real payment or all-device end-to-end acceptance is claimed for this release.
Specialized counts overlap the domain gate and must not be added as independent coverage.
The staged credential scan checks common formats and forbidden files; it is not a complete static proof of absence of secrets.
